project: An imported CC0 medieval castle (3D Shorts look development, not a publishable documentary)

audio.speaker: Ryan
audio.instruct: Clear, energetic educational narrator; conversational, not theatrical.

shots.intent: Wide reveal of exact licensed prefab castle
shots.spoken: Here is a complete medieval castle model, not a painted backdrop. Every stone tower and wall is genuine three dimensional geometry.
shots.caption: IMPORTED 3D CASTLE

shots.intent: Look directly at perimeter curtain masonry
shots.spoken: From this angle, the curtain wall forms the first major line of protection around the inner buildings.
shots.caption: CURTAIN WALLS

shots.spoken: The main entrance leads toward a fortified gatehouse. Look closely at the opening beneath its towers.
shots.caption: FORTIFIED GATE

shots.intent: Close view of actual imported round tower
shots.spoken: These round corner towers give the walls another view of the surrounding ground. Their shapes remain visible as the camera moves.
shots.caption: ROUND TOWERS

shots.intent: Slow perspective pullback revealing castle silhouette
shots.spoken: Now the full castle comes into view, including the central keep, courtyard and surrounding defensive walls.
shots.caption: FULL CASTLE VIEW

shots.spoken: The tallest building is the keep. It rises above the outer fortifications and forms the visual center of this castle.
shots.caption: THE CENTRAL KEEP

shots.intent: Return to complete asset with closing caption
shots.spoken: We can reuse this complete licensed model for differently directed short videos. The graphics are imported; the storytelling is edited.
shots.caption: FREE CC0 3D ASSETS

description: Every building, character, tree, floor tile and sky image is a downloaded pre-existing CC0 source asset. No generated 3D meshes.
